title: Native flat-term K-flat étale complexes in scalar coordinates
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and X a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let P be an integer complex of sheaves of A-modules on its small étale site. Suppose P is categorically K-flat and each term is categorically flat [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso]. Under the canonical constant-ring scalar realization [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor], P is K-flat for the independent-coefficients acyclic-tensor test [def-pc-kflat-complex] and every term is flat on the site [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].

proof.text: The two canonical constant-ring comparisons are inverse. Thus the realization is the existing tensor realization equivalence; its flatness comparison makes it preserve flat objects and its equivalence makes it preserve integer colimits.
Apply preservation of flat-term K-flat complexes by such additive functors. To obtain the acyclic-tensor test, tensor the quasi-isomorphism 0→Z for an arbitrary acyclic Z; the image of zero is zero.

theorem ringedComplex_flat_kFlat (P : Complexes A X)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (Modules A X) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (hf : ∀ n, ObjectProperty.flat (P.X n)) :
    CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients ((ringedComplex A X).obj P) ∧
      ∀ n, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite
        (J := X.smallEtaleTopology) (R := realizationRing X.smallEtaleTopology A)
        ((ringedRealization A X).obj (P.X n))
